name: Shirakawa (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shirakawa city emblem in blue and red: a blue stylised swirl of a curved stroke and dots, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shirakawa, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 November 2005.

features.role: Shirakawa city emblem — a blue stylised swirl of a curved stroke and dots, with a red disc
